GDO-L: Grassroots Directed Overlay with Labels
An *identity* is a unique key pair, chosen by the person who has it.
Alice *trusts* Bob when she knows Bob personally and believes him to keep the undertakings he signs under grassroots contracts.
A pointer may be labeled by a person, and a pointer labeled by Dave is a *Dave-pointer*. Friends Alice and Bob have a Bob-pointer from Alice to Bob and an Alice-pointer from Bob to Alice.
Alice, Bob and Carol are persons. A party to a contract must have an identity. Alice and Bob are persons. Alice, Bob, Carol and Dave are persons, Carol and Dave possibly one person.
GKK:1. ○ Establish: Alice may establish an identity once. Alice will make herself known by its public key, sign her acts with its private key, and be accountable for every act signed with it.
GKK:2. ■ Acquaint: Alice and Bob may jointly come to know each other.
GKK:3. ■ Introduce: Alice may introduce Carol to Bob with the consent of Bob, provided Alice and Bob know each other and Alice knows Carol.
GSG:1. ○ Befriend: Alice and Bob, who trust each other and are not friends, may jointly become friends.
GSG:2. ■ Unfriend: Alice may end her friendship with Bob.
GSG:3. ○ Loss of Trust. Alice will end her friendship with Bob if she ceases to trust him.
GDO:1. ■ Point friend: Alice, who does not point to her friend Bob, may point to Bob.
GDO:2. ■ Point transitive: Alice, who knows Carol and points to Bob who points to Carol, may point to Carol.
GDO:3. ■ Unpoint: Alice, who points to Bob, may cease pointing to Bob.
GDO-L:1. ■ Labeled point friend: Alice, who has no Dave-pointer to her friend Bob, may add one, if Bob has a Dave-pointer.
GDO-L:2. ■ Labeled point transitive: Alice, who knows Carol and either has a Dave-pointer to Bob or is Bob's friend, may add a Dave-pointer to Carol, if Bob has a Dave-pointer to Carol.
GDO-L:3. ■ Labeled unpoint: Alice, who has a Dave-pointer to Bob, may remove it.
